name: Zattu
overview: Zattu is identified in Scripture as the ancestor of a significant group whose descendants returned to Jerusalem with Zerubbabel, numbering 945 according to Ezra 2:8 and 845 in Nehemiah 7:13. The name Zattu is likely synonymous with Zatthu, who is mentioned as one of the leaders sealing the covenant with Nehemiah in Nehemiah 10:14. The sons of Zattu are also listed among the post-exilic community, highlighting their role in the restoration period as faithful participants in the covenant renewal (Ezra 10:27). This connection underscores the faithfulness of Zattu’s lineage in the reestablishment of God's people after the exile.
